title: Low-pressure cutoff required on booster pumps.
officialText:
A low-pressure cutoff shall be installed on all booster pumps in a water
pressure booster system to prevent creation of a vacuum or negative pressure on the suction side of the pump when a positive
pressure of 10 psi (68.94 kPa) or less occurs on the suction side of the pump.
